facts.statement: The second phase of play is called the Machine Phase.
facts.sourceSentence: PHASE II: THE MACHINE PHASE:

facts.statement: At the start of the machine phase, the player works through the row of machine parts in play in left-to-right order, cycling each card's track and resolving its abilities.
facts.sourceSentence: At the start of the machine phase, go from left to right down the row of machine parts in play, cycling each card's track and resolving its abilities as follows:

facts.statement: Cycling a machine part card means moving its yellow die one space down that card's cycle track.
facts.sourceSentence: 1) Move a machine part card's yellow die 1 space down its cycle track.

facts.statement: If the moved die comes to rest on an icon, the ability corresponding to that icon triggers immediately.
facts.sourceSentence: If that dice lands on an icon, immediately trigger that icon's corresponding ability.

facts.statement: In the worked example, the Soul Harvester card's HP die moves one space down its track and lands on a damage icon, triggering that icon's ability.
facts.sourceSentence: The HP die for Soul Harvester will cycle one space down the track, triggering its [damage icon] ability, which will deal 5 damage to the player.

facts.statement: The damage ability triggered in the example deals 5 damage to the player.
facts.sourceSentence: ...triggering its [damage icon] ability, which will deal 5 damage to the player.

facts.statement: Shields can prevent some or all of incoming damage, depending on how many the player has.
facts.sourceSentence: If they don't have enough shields to prevent some or all of that damage.

facts.statement: Damage that is not blocked carries over and reduces the player's HP directly.
facts.sourceSentence: Unblocked damage carries over and reduces HP directly.

facts.statement: If a die's move would place it on a dead space (a darkened square), the die is instead returned to the starting position of its track.
facts.sourceSentence: Note: If moving the die places it on a dead space (darkened square), then move that die back to the starting position on the track.

facts.statement: Dead spaces on a cycle track are shown as darkened squares.
facts.sourceSentence: If moving the die places it on a dead space (darkened square)...

facts.statement: A machine part card's cycle track runs vertically down the left side of the card as a column of square spaces.
facts.sourceSentence: Down its left side runs a vertical cycle track of square spaces; a yellow die sits on one space with a white downward arrow showing it moving one space to the next space, which bears a green/teal damage icon.

facts.statement: A machine part card lists its icon effects as labeled strips beside the track; the example card's effects are "DEAL 5 DMG" and "TAKE 1 DMG".
facts.sourceSentence: below it two labeled yellow strips reading "DEAL 5 DMG" and "TAKE 1 DMG" (the card's icon effects)

facts.statement: A machine part card carries a roll-condition row expressed as three die faces.
facts.sourceSentence: To the right of the track are yellow roll-condition tiles: a "? - ? - ?" style three-die condition row

facts.statement: A machine part card shows an HP/health value along its bottom edge together with additional small icons.
facts.sourceSentence: The card's HP/health value and additional small icons appear along the bottom edge.

facts.statement: After finishing one card, play proceeds rightward to the next machine part card and repeats the cycling process.
facts.sourceSentence: 2) Proceed to the next machine part card in the line (moving right) and repeat the card cycling process until all part cards have increased their cycle track by 1 and resolved any abilities/effects that are triggered.

facts.statement: The cycling process repeats until every machine part card has advanced its cycle track by one and resolved any triggered abilities or effects.
facts.sourceSentence: ...until all part cards have increased their cycle track by 1 and resolved any abilities/effects that are triggered.

facts.statement: Once all cards have cycled, the entire machine part card row is slid one space to the right.
facts.sourceSentence: 3) Now, carefully slide the entire machine part card row one space to the right.

facts.statement: A new machine part card is drawn and placed into the space opened by sliding the row.
facts.sourceSentence: Draw a new machine part card and slot it into the available space.

facts.statement: A yellow HP die is placed on the first cycle tracking space of the newly drawn card.
facts.sourceSentence: 4) Add a yellow HP die to the first cycle tracking space on the new card, setting the die face to the correct starting HP value for that card.

facts.statement: The newly placed HP die is set to the face matching that card's own starting HP value.
facts.sourceSentence: ...setting the die face to the correct starting HP value for that card.

facts.statement: No more than 10 machine parts may be in play at any time.
facts.sourceSentence: Note: there can never be more than 10 machine parts in play at any given time.

facts.statement: When 10 machine part cards are already active on the line, the draw of a new card is skipped and play continues.
facts.sourceSentence: If 10 cards are active on the line, then skip drawing a new card and proceed with play.

facts.statement: The machine cycle is complete once all machine part cards have cycled and a new card has been added to the line.
facts.sourceSentence: When all machine part cards have cycled and a new card is added to the line, gather all of your spent dice (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts) and return to Phase I.

facts.statement: At the end of the machine cycle the player gathers all of their spent dice and returns to Phase I.
facts.sourceSentence: ...gather all of your spent dice (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts) and return to Phase I.

facts.statement: Dice newly obtained by defeating machine parts are included in the dice gathered at the end of the machine cycle.
facts.sourceSentence: (including any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts)

facts.statement: Defeating a machine part can award the player new dice.
facts.sourceSentence: ...any new dice you may have obtained by defeating machine parts...
